scripts.build: npm run build -w @zoomport/core && npm run build -w @zoomport/dom && npm run build -w @zoomport/react && npm run build -w @zoomport/effect && npm run build -w @zoomport/playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zoomport/core && npm run build -w @zoomport/core && npm run typecheck -w @zoomport/dom && npm run build -w @zoomport/dom && npm run typecheck -w @zoomport/react && npm run build -w @zoomport/react && npm run typecheck -w @zoomport/effect && npm run typecheck -w @zoomport/playground
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w @zoomport/core && npm run build -w @zoomport/dom && npm run build -w @zoomport/react && playwright test
scripts.bench:browser: npm run build -w @zoomport/core && npm run build -w @zoomport/dom && npm run build -w @zoomport/react && playwright test -c playwright.bench.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @zoomport/core && npm run build -w @zoomport/dom && npm run build -w @zoomport/react && npm run dev -w @zoomport/playground
scripts.dev:lan: npm run build -w @zoomport/core && npm run build -w @zoomport/dom && npm run build -w @zoomport/react && npm run dev -w @zoomport/playground -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 11274 --strictPort
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke:global
